limits.notes: Rate limited to 5,000 requests/hour per key (HTTP 429 over limit). Uses the api.data.gov key infrastructure.

llmDocs.summary: Legislative data: bills, resolutions, amendments, members, committees, the Congressional Record, nominations, and treaties from 1973 onward.
llmDocs.queryGuide: Set format=json. Bills are addressed by congress number + bill type (hr, s, hjres, sjres, etc.) + number. Use /bill?fromDateTime=&sort=updateDate+desc for recent activity. Paginate with limit (max 250) and offset.

exampleQueries.intent: Detail for H.R. 1 of the 119th Congress

gotchas: Bill text, actions, cosponsors are sub-resources requiring follow-up requests (URLs provided in the detail response).
Bill type must be lowercase (hr, s) in the path.
5,000/hour limit shared across all calls on the key — paginate efficiently.
Same key works across other api.data.gov services.

compliance.redistributionNotes: Public domain legislative information. Attribution to Congress.gov / Library of Congress requested.
